title: Part 3 JUXTAPOSITIONS
text: Part 3 JUXTAPOSITIONS The history of the . . . snail has been more copiously considered than that of the elephant; and its anatomy is as well, if not better, known: however, not to give any one object more room in the general picture of nature than it is entitled to, it will be sufficient to observe that the snail is surprisingly fitted for the life it is formed to lead. — O LIVER G OLDSMITH , A History of the Earth and Animated Nature, 1774
